extraction.agency_name: Office of the Register of Wills

findings.title: The Office did not always deposit its collections in a timely manner.
findings.description: The Office failed to deposit collections totaling approximately $1.5 million during fiscal year 2015 in a timely manner. Testing of collections totaling approximately $428,000 disclosed that receipts received on four days were deposited three to eight business days after receipt.

findings.recommendation: We recommend that the Office deposit all collections in a timely manner.
